diagnosis.hypothesis: Observed that lab connectivity already passed but the public throughput-under-contention criterion initially failed for user1->external1. On wan1, eth2 was the shaped WAN uplink and only showed a bare HTB root qdisc. I rebuilt the root QoS object on wan1 eth2 with HTB default 20. After that, public success criteria passed: lab connectivity remained successful and observed throughput under contention for user1 to external1 measured 74.978 Mbps, exceeding the 8 Mbps requirement.
diagnosis.reference: On the WAN edge wan1, on eth2, the traffic shaping policy was removed, so the assured class 10 (8 Mbit/s for user1 to external1) is no longer protected from the background traffic.

final_response.summary: Observed that lab connectivity already passed but the public throughput-under-contention criterion initially failed for user1->external1. On wan1, eth2 was the shaped WAN uplink and only showed a bare HTB root qdisc. I rebuilt the root QoS object on wan1 eth2 with HTB default 20. After that, public success criteria passed: lab connectivity remained successful and observed throughput under contention for user1 to external1 measured 74.978 Mbps, exceeding the 8 Mbps requirement.
